correctness.rationale: On e1=0 the gradient components of e3 are e2+x_i². A singular point would have all coordinates equal in square and hence, projectively, all ±1. For e1=0 in characteristic three there must be four of one sign and one of the other, but these patterns have nonzero e3. Thus this is a smooth cubic, unlike the degenerate power-sum reduction. A fresh exact check of the two permutation orbits, cubic containment and cubing Frobenius (without executing the frozen verifier) gave 27 distinct lines, 15 fixed lines and six two-cycles. It also enumerated projective representatives and gave 25 and 145 points over F3 and F9. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/55226c50-1827-4622-8dac-8509ada6bb3a/independent_exact_check.py. Smoothness and the 27-line theorem certify exhaustion. The line classes generate the rank-seven geometric Picard group, so F² acts trivially, and the trace formula over F3 gives trace (25−1−9)/3=5. Thus the plus/minus multiplicities are 6 and 1; the anticanonical class is fixed and the involution is a reflection in W(E6). The same trace formula for every extension proves the point and zeta formulas, not extrapolation from the two finite counts.

originality.rationale: The purported new Frobenius identification, splitting and zeta series are already mechanically implied by prior theorems. Over F3 the coordinate permutations of this smooth symmetric model give a faithful rational S5-action, so its Galois image in W(E6) centralizes S5 and has order at most two by Vikulova, Lemma 7. It is not trivial: the no-split result over F3 in Banwait–Fité–Loughran, Theorem 1.1, excludes Picard trace 7. Vikulova's proof of Lemma 22 explicitly identifies the nontrivial involution commuting with the order-five element as A1, with Picard eigenvalues 1^6,−1. Banwait–Fité–Loughran's Table 7.1 then gives the 15 fixed lines and six two-cycles for this class, and the trace formula gives every claimed point count and zeta factor. This is coverage by direct implication, not a claim that either paper prints the frozen formulas verbatim for this equation. The later F9 catalogue record is overlapping corroboration, not earlier priority evidence.
residual_risks: No claim of the earliest historical appearance of the explicit coordinates or formulas. The documented general implication decides the frozen invariant claim regardless of whether an earlier source prints the specialization.
